FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something strange. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his advisors, a group of stern-looking men in suits.

KING (he) "I have had enough of this drab, medieval aesthetic. It's time for a change. I want our kingdom to be the most...futuristic...of all time."

ADVISOR 1 (he) "But, sire, what do you mean? We're a medieval kingdom, after all."

KING (he) "Exactly. That's why it's time for a revolution. I want our architecture to be a fusion of ancient and modern, with a dash of...vaporwave."

ADVISOR 2 (he) "Vaporwave? I'm not sure I understand, sire."

KING (he) "It's a style, my friends. A style that combines the nostalgia of the past with the futurism of the future. Think...retro-futurism."

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his advisors, who are all staring at him in confusion.

KING (he) "I want our castle to be a giant, neon-lit monument to our greatness. And our clothes...our clothes will be a fusion of medieval and futuristic. Think... metallic fabrics, and...glow-in-the-dark accents."

ADVISOR 3 (he) "But, sire, what about the peasants? They'll be confused by all this...futuristic...business."

KING (he) "Confused? Ha! They'll be...entranced. They'll be...mesmerized by our...vaporwave aesthetic."

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The king's advisors are busy implementing the king's vision. They are constructing a massive, neon-lit castle, with metallic fabrics and glow-in-the-dark accents. The peasants are staring in confusion, but the king is thrilled.

KING (he) "It's...it's...beautiful. Isn't it, my friends?"

ADVISOR 1 (he) "Yes, sire. It's...um... quite something."

KING (he) "I know, right? I'm a visionary. A...a...futurist king."

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is sitting on his throne, surrounded by his advisors. He is wearing a metallic, glow-in-the-dark cloak, and his beard is styled in a futuristic, neon-lit fashion.

KING (he) "I want our kingdom to be the most...futuristic...of all time. I want our people to be...entranced...by our...vaporwave aesthetic."

ADVISOR 2 (he) "But, sire, what about the...medieval...aspects of our kingdom? The knights, the castles, the...peasants?"

KING (he) "Ah, those are just...details. Details that can be...retrofitted...with our...vaporwave aesthetic."

ADVISOR 3 (he) "I see what you mean, sire. You want to...merge...the past and the future."

KING (he) "Exactly. I want our kingdom to be a...a...futuristic...utopia. A place where the past and the future...coexist...in harmony."

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a surreal, vaporwave-inspired landscape. The castle is a giant, neon-lit monument, and the peasants are dressed in metallic, glow-in-the-dark clothing. The king is standing on the balcony, looking out over the kingdom.

KING (he) "It's...it's...beautiful. Isn't it, my friends?"

ADVISOR 1 (he) "Yes, sire. It's...um... quite something."

KING (he) "I know, right? I'm a...a...futurist king. A...a...visionary."

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
